# Heat (generated by cases/thermal.py)

Room 22 °C. The NEMA 34's loss is 2 I^2 R with R 0.7 ohm per phase at 20 °C, rising with its winding's temperature; v3 and v4 put it inside their closed acrylic enclosures, the paternoster in the room. Motor and plate shed heat by natural convection and radiation; the enclosure passes it to the room through its walls.
